title: The ether meditation
line: Twenty minutes, from the objects in the room to the space of awareness that holds them.
intro: Athena treats ether (αἰθήρ), the fifth element and Plato’s element of the gods, as space and consciousness. In this meditation, the fullest in the Practical Guide, you move from the objects around you to the space they sit in, and from a thought to the awareness in which it appears. It answers Apollo’s call at Delphi, which Athena reads as consciousness turning to know itself.
does: Twenty minutes moving attention from objects to the space of awareness that holds them.
trains: Recognising yourself as the open awareness in which everything appears.

steps.text: Sit upright and at ease. Eyes open: look at the objects in the room and how they stand to you.
Shift your attention from the objects to the space they sit in. Notice the body relax, the heart open, the gaze widen.
Close your eyes, find the breath, and feel the space inside.
Place one short thought or image at the centre of the mind’s screen, and breathe with it.
Shift attention from that thought to the space it appears in, which is there before it and after it.
Recognise its qualities: vast, open, softly alive, luminous, timeless. Recognise it as the “I” that sees and hears.
Feel that space through the neck, the heart, the hands, the belly, the back, the legs, the soles: the space breathes the body.
Let body, awareness and space merge into the present: the inner and the outer space are one.
Open your eyes, and keep the recognition as the forms start to move again.
